condition: When several interceptors are registered separately, an error thrown by a success interceptor is only caught by the error handler in the same use() pair or a later one, not by error interceptors registered earlier. A value returned from an error interceptor also skips success handlers registered ear
workaround: Register the success and error handlers together in one use(onFulfilled, onRejected) call, or put the error handling inside a single interceptor, and don't count on handlers from other use() calls running.
